reason: Case 7 + regression pattern (a)/(b) hybrid — the three plan-gate reports alternate between two MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE demands on the same two nodes ('member def:graph-class is not an assumption' when the plan mirrors the core, vs 'plan omits core member def:graph-class' when the plan flattens), so no plan.json can pass; the producer is bouncing off an upstream defect it cannot see. Root cause is in discovery/core.json (a Stage-0 artifact): `def:model-class` (core.json:1086-1089) and `def:bounded-outcome-model-class` (core.json:1306-1309) put def-valued component classes in `by_member_properties`, a field the gate requires to contain assumption atoms only; the core's own correct idiom for def-valued dependencies is `inputs` (cf. `def:two-class-minimax-risks`, core.json:1335-1338). This overrides the per-boundary heuristic's stage_1 default (re-plan is provably insufficient — attempts 1 and 3 already tried the only two encodings the gate permits). stage_1 cannot reach core.json and stage_4d is .tex-equation-scoped, so stage_0 is the closest sufficient rewind.

Leave each node's `construction`, `free_symbols`, and every other core node (including `def:graph-class`, `def:coefficient-class`, `def:bounded-outcome-coefficient-class`, whose `by_member_properties` are already assumption atoms) untouched; the .tex needs no edit.

perItemFindings.label: def:minimax-risk
perItemFindings.one_line: `Estimator V := (V → Bool) → (V → ℝ) → ℝ` is graph-blind, while the core permits a single estimator measurable in `(G,Z,Yobs)`; fixing `G` inside `riskAt` changes the inf–sup problem and makes `snipeEstimator G` not one admissible global competitor.

perItemFindings.label: S4
perItemFindings.one_line: The cited `Causalean.Stat.integral_min_le_one_sub_tvDist` and `sq_bhattacharyya_le_two_mul_integral_min` both require `P₊ ≪ P₋`; the planned compactly supported translated cosine-square laws have non-nested supports, so that absolute-continuity premise fails.

review.verbatim_critique: Re-plan `def:minimax-risk`/S3 with a graph-aware estimator rule, then compose it with each model's graph before applying `FiniteDesign.mse`. Re-plan the S4 converse: retain generic `tvDist`/Le Cam reuse, but replace the unusable RN-derivative Bretagnolle–Huber route with a locally proved common-dominating-density affinity-to-TV inequality for the explicit counting⊗Lebesgue densities (and then tensorize that affinity).

perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.Stat.mixtureReal_le` only applies to a `Fintype`-indexed finite sum, but the cosine-squared baseline prior over `U : Fin m → ℝ` is continuous; it cannot discharge the stated realizability step.
